title: Determined Game
body_html:
Determined Game

A simple two-player game is determined if one of the two players has a winning strategy.

Because the winning sets $R_1$ and $R_2$ are disjoint, both players cannot have winning strategies simultaneously.

References

  • [MFoGT, Def. 6.2.2] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MathFoundationsGameTheory.pdf. A game is determined if one player has a winning strategy.
